HOW IT WORKS

One step at a time.

Get familiar with the application process
in the LIVAYA app.

  1. 01

    Find the app

    Look for LIVAYA in your app store and check the app name before downloading.

  2. 02

    Register your details

    Start with your phone number and follow the instructions in the app.

  3. 03

    Complete your application

    Provide the requested information and review your loan and repayment details.

  4. 04

    Check the result

    If approved, follow the instructions in the app for receiving your funds.

An application is subject to review. Check the full loan details and repayment schedule before accepting an offer.
